items_flat.title_en: EU AI Act transparency rules and GPAI enforcement powers take effect
items_flat.title_zh: 歐盟AI法案透明度規則與GPAI執法權正式生效
items_flat.summary_en: From 2 August 2026 the European Commission’s AI Office and national competent authorities begin enforcing key AI Act provisions. Transparency obligations (Article 50) require providers to inform users of direct AI interactions and add machine-readable marks to synthetic content; deployers must disclose deepfakes, certain public-interest AI text, and emotion-recognition or biometric systems. GPAI model obligations also become enforceable, with fines up to €15 million or 3% of worldwide annual turnover.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自2026年8月2日起，歐盟執委會AI辦公室與各成員國主管機關開始執行AI法案關鍵條款。透明度義務（第50條）要求提供者告知用戶正在與AI互動並為合成內容加入機器可讀標記；部署者須揭露deepfake、特定公共利益AI文字，以及情緒辨識或生物特徵系統。GPAI模型義務同步可執法，最高罰款1,500萬歐元或全球年營業額3%。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first major operational enforcement wave of the AI Act for frontier labs serving the EU. High-risk system rules were deferred, but GPAI providers and transparency duties now carry real financial and operational risk, likely accelerating industry adoption of watermarking and disclosure practices.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是AI法案對服務歐盟市場的前沿實驗室首次實質執法浪潮。高風險系統規則已延後，但GPAI提供者與透明度義務現已具備真正財務與營運風險，可能加速產業採用浮水印與揭露實務。
items_flat.quote: From 2 August 2026, the AI Office and authorities of the Member States are responsible for implementing, supervising and enforcing the AI Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自2026年8月2日起，AI辦公室與成員國主管機關負責執行、監督與執法AI法案。

items_flat.title_en: Microsoft Project Perception multi-agent cybersecurity system enters public preview
items_flat.title_zh: 微軟Project Perception多代理網路安全系統進入公開預覽
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft’s Project Perception, an agentic security system with coordinated red, blue and green agents, enters public preview on 3 August 2026. It uses the in-house MAI-Cyber-1-Flash model for the majority of vulnerability and security workflows (claimed 96% on CyberGym, roughly half the cost of prior configurations) and routes the hardest tasks to larger models such as GPT-5.4.
items_flat.summary_zh: 微軟的Project Perception多代理安全系統（含紅隊、藍隊、綠隊代理協調）於2026年8月3日進入公開預覽。系統以自研MAI-Cyber-1-Flash模型處理多數漏洞與安全工作流程（宣稱CyberGym達96%，成本約先前配置一半），並將最困難任務路由至GPT-5.4等較大模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: The preview marks Microsoft’s concrete move into specialised agentic cybersecurity, pairing a purpose-built smaller model with larger general models. Independent verification of the CyberGym claim and real-world deployment scale remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此次預覽標誌微軟正式進入專用代理式網路安全領域，結合自研較小模型與大型通用模型。CyberGym宣稱成績的獨立驗證與實際部署規模仍是待觀察重點。
items_flat.quote: We are bringing this vision to customers around the world through Project Perception, which enters public preview on August 3.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們透過Project Perception將此願景帶給全球客戶，該系統於8月3日進入公開預覽。

links.label: Microsoft Blog – Rethinking security for the age of AI

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk highlights Grok’s ability to analyze any uploaded video
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克強調Grok可分析任何上傳影片的能力
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that “Grok can analyze any video,” sharing a demonstration link. Grok confirmed it samples frames across the video, runs vision analysis for scenes, objects, motion and artifacts, transcribes the audio track, and fuses the results, including deepfake detection.
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克發文表示「Grok可以分析任何影片」，並分享示範連結。Grok確認會對影片取樣影格、進行場景／物件／動態與偽影視覺分析、轉錄音軌並融合結果，包括深度偽造偵測。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an executive product-capability signal rather than a formal model or API launch. It reinforces Grok’s already-shipping multimodal vision stack, but length limits, sampling density and provenance tracing remain practical constraints for users.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是高階產品能力訊號，而非正式模型或API發布。它強化Grok已上線的多模態視覺能力，但影片長度限制、取樣密度與來源追蹤仍是實務限制。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk highlights Grok Build CLI improvements (v0.2.119)
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克強調Grok Build編碼CLI更新（v0.2.119）
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted “Grok Build improvements” linking to x.ai/cli and amplifying release notes for v0.2.119. The update expands Auto mode (more read-only git commands and safe appends), allows free-form glob patterns for bash always-allow permissions, adds jump-to-start arrows for long responses, Mermaid diagram buttons in plan previews, faster /btw side questions via cache reuse, and multiple reliability and performance fixes.
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克發文「Grok Build improvements」並連結x.ai/cli，轉發v0.2.119更新說明。此次更新擴展Auto模式（更多唯讀git指令與安全附加）、bash always-allow改為自由格式glob權限、長回覆新增跳至開頭箭頭、Plan預覽加入Mermaid圖表按鈕、透過快取重用加速/btw側問，以及多項可靠性與效能修復。
items_flat.analysis_en: A continuous product iteration on xAI’s coding agent rather than a model release. The changes focus on developer ergonomics and safer automation, consistent with Grok Build’s positioning as a terminal-native agentic coding tool.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是xAI編碼代理的持續產品迭代，而非模型釋出。更新聚焦開發者體驗與更安全的自動化，符合Grok Build作為終端原生代理編碼工具的定位。

No major new model releases from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind or Meta.
